en.io: Inputs are an idea, prompt, task, project cache/memory, optional depth and brief flags, and clarification answers. Outputs are files under .hyperflow/specs, .hyperflow/tasks, .hyperflow/features, and memory, plus an optional committed cross-session handoff package.
en.boundary: Planning never implements source code and never silently starts dispatch. It must persist the plan artifacts and always ask whether to build in the current session, another session, or later. Material ambiguity requires user input; headless execution stops rather than selecting a build path automatically.
dependencies: Agent workers and reviewers for the described workflow
scenarios: Sharpen a vague prompt before engineering work.
Design a multi-subsystem feature and compare approaches.
Decompose a clear task into ordered batches and build-ready worker briefs.

zh.io: 输入为想法、提示或任务、项目缓存/记忆、可选深度与简报参数及澄清答案；输出为 .hyperflow/specs、.hyperflow/tasks、.hyperflow/features 和记忆文件，以及可选的已提交跨会话交接包。
zh.boundary: plan 不实现源码，也不得静默启动 dispatch。必须将规划产物写入磁盘，并始终询问在当前会话、另一会话还是以后构建。实质性歧义需要用户输入；无交互环境应停止，不能自动选择构建路径。
dependencies: 对 .hyperflow 目录的读写权限
所述流程需要的工作代理和审阅代理
提交交接包可选依赖 Git
scenarios: 在工程实施前强化模糊需求。
设计跨多个子系统的功能并比较方案。
把清晰任务拆分为有顺序的批次和可直接实施的工作简报。
